definitions.formula: 100 × huck attempts / physical throw attempts; pooled counts, not an average of player or possession percentages.

providerFormula.text: Share of all throws that are huck attempts.

definitions.huck: Straight-line endpoint distance >40 yards AND forward gain >30 yards. Teddy confirmed on November 13, 2026 that this is the identical ShownSpace cutoff, from the equation Braden provided. The formula and cutoff match; this research slice and saved snapshot are not the full live dashboard population.

huckDefinitionProvenance.source: User confirmation in research chat, citing equation supplied by Braden at ShownSpace

definitions.attempt: Completed and incomplete physical passes, including drops and throwaways. Excludes pulls, stalls and non-throw events. Centering passes remain included.
definitions.unit: Throw attempts by the original seven receiving-point players, grouped by their own first, second, or later possession within that point.
definitions.lineup: Retain actions strictly before the audited first personnel change or uncertain/contradictory lineup record. Keep pre-change attempts even when a replacement line finishes the possession. Preserve original possession numbers.
definitions.timeout: A timeout alone does not delete an attempt. Retain original-seven actions before the cutoff, including before a timeout/substitution and after same-seven timeouts. The earlier exclusion of timeout-containing possessions is retained as a sensitivity check.
definitions.periodEnd: Include attempts in period-ending possessions; this throw-level denominator does not require a completed possession outcome.
definitions.location: All starts or original first throwing location at least 60 yards from the attacking goal line (first_y <=40 on the 120-yard coordinate system). Starting location remains before any centering pass; it is a recorded throwing-location proxy, not a verified pull-catching spot. The 60-yard cutoff does not exactly match field positions.
definitions.comparison: Second minus first. Opening baseline contains all eligible openings, not only openings followed by a second possession. Later possessions are conditional on losing the disc and recovering it with the original line.
definitions.uncertainty: 10000 whole-game bootstrap draws with shared weights across possession groups. Team ranges are exploratory individual intervals, not simultaneous intervals or a ranking of proven team differences. No context model or CP model is needed for these observed counts.
definitions.interpretation: A greater share of passes being hucks does not by itself establish earlier hucks, more possessions containing a huck, greater completion probability, fatigue or impatience.
